scope: Assistant structured extraction from verified v1 abstracts, not independent human labels or a full-text/experimental review

control.value: 推理深度与文本推理长度
control.evidence: dynamically adapts reasoning depth based on question characteristics

selection.value: 依据问题特征，结合难度相关指标与奖励
selection.evidence: model-based metrics for question characterization, an adaptive thinking reward mechanism, and difficulty-aware KL regularization

control.value: 复杂问题才引入关键视觉提示；简单问题直接推理
control.evidence: For straightforward questions, FOCUS supports efficient zero-shot reasoning. For more complex tasks, it employs the conceptualizing before observation strategy to highlight critical elements.

selection.value: 根据问题复杂度结合快速直觉与审慎推理
selection.evidence: dynamically adapts to the complexity of questions, combining fast intuitive judgments with deliberate analytical reasoning

control.value: 快慢双模式与推理token效率
control.evidence: automatically switch between fast and slow thinking modes depending on task difficulty

selection.value: 先按输出长度标记模式，再用GRPO学习快慢模式
selection.evidence: we label data as either requiring fast thinking or slow thinking based on the model output length

training.value: 需要：摘要明确说明用GRPO训练
training.evidence: we train the model using GRPO along with the thinking mode labels to develop dual-mode thinking

control.value: 联合选择视觉计算形式和推理深度
control.evidence: jointly optimizes the form and depth of computation

selection.value: 模态路由奖励选择模式，难度感知策略调节深度
selection.evidence: introduces a modality-aware routing reward to select appropriate reasoning modes and a difficulty-aware fast-slow strategy to adapt reasoning depth according to task complexity

control.value: 在原top-k专家中重分配权重，控制推理深度
control.evidence: redistributes routing weights within the original top-k set according to sample difficulty

selection.value: 简单问题增强快专家，困难问题反向调整
selection.evidence: It amplifies fast-thinking experts and suppresses slow-thinking experts on easy inputs and reverses this adjustment on hard ones

training.value: 不需要训练：摘要明确称training-free
